The query has 305 windows. Let me look at the features:
- variance_log_ratio: mean 0.0022, std 0.3387, trend 0.0038 (slightly increasing)
- ac1: mean 0.2861, std 0.1057, trend 0.0832 (increasing autocorrelation - classic early warning signal)
- skewness: mean -0.0292, std 0.2205, trend -0.0874 (decreasing)
- kurtosis: mean -0.0679, std 0.3485, trend -0.0371
- trend_slope: mean 0.1322, std 0.5951, trend -0.3032 (decreasing trend slope)
- tau_variance: mean 0.0161, std 0.3801, trend -0.0345
- tau_ac1: mean 0.0014, std 0.3374, trend -0.0477
- low_freq_power: mean 0.2562, std 0.0825, trend 0.0632 (increasing)

The increasing ac1 (autocorrelation at lag 1) is a classic critical slowing down indicator - as systems approach tipping points, autocorrelation tends to increase. The increasing low_freq_power also suggests more power at low frequencies, another early warning signal. The decreasing trend_slope could indicate the system is losing resilience.

Now I should run the PFN model to get actual predictions.
